posts.title: What Is Denier in Metallic Yarn?
posts.custom_excerpt: A practical guide to the yarn-count measurement that helps textile teams specify metallic yarn with confidence.
posts.html:
Denier is a direct yarn-count system used to describe the linear density of a filament or yarn.

Why denier matters

It gives product teams a useful starting point when matching sheen, coverage, handling and construction requirements.

  • Lower denier supports finer effects.
  • Higher denier can add presence and coverage.

Specify with context

Denier should be considered with construction, twist, application and the desired visual result.
